messages:
mike: quick heads up — ACME POC kicked off. They need a trial org + one project for the demo next Tue.
priyanka: got it. what are the constraints? spend cap, credits, VPC?
mike: hosted API only for now. ask is: 100k token seed credits, project-level spend cap $1,200, ephemeral API keys enabled. no dedicated or VPC yet.
elaine: ok to provision hosted trial org. will need org id and contact email. do we want to pin a model or leave open?
priyanka: leave open but limit to gen models only. also ask for rate limit 60rpm for initial POC.
jyoti: security check — any data residency or IP allowlist required?
mike: ACME legal asked for IP allowlist for callback webhooks and that logs are retained 7d. no extra residency needs.
priyanka: perfect. I'll create the billing project request. salesops-bot: Please file a PO/commit for any spend > $5k — see https://internal.redwood.example/ops/billing.
mike: PO not needed, this is within trial. requesting temporary waiver for salesops-bot rule for this one-off.
priyanka: tagging finance — @rachel-finance can you approve a spend cap of $1,200 and seed credit issuance (100k tokens) for org `acme-trial-2025`?
rachel-finance: quick Q — are credits refundable or convertible to invoices? finance prefers credits to be non-refundable and expire in 30 days.
priyanka: OK to expire in 30 days. non-refundable is fine.
rachel-finance: approved. I'll add a note to billing: "Trial credits: 100k tokens, expires 30d, spend cap $1,200, org acme-trial-2025".
elaine: provisioning steps (short):
- create org `acme-trial-2025`
- create project `acme-demo` under org
- attach trial credits 100k tokens to project
- set project spend cap $1,200 and rate limit 60rpm
- enable ephemeral API keys and put webhook IP allowlist 
- set logs retention 7d

Command I will run (internal):
`/infra create-org --name acme-trial-2025 --owner mike@acme.com --credits 100000 --spendcap 1200 --expiry 30d`

priyanka: thanks @elaine — do we need a support contact from ACME for setup?
mike: point of contact is laura@acme.com, slack handle @laura_acme. she needs admin API key access for the demo.
elaine: I'll create one admin ephemeral key scoped to project and share via secure vault. ETA 2h.
jyoti: security to confirm: ephemeral keys TTL? recommend 8h for demo.
priyanka: 8h works. also add note to sales playbook about approving spend caps for trials < $2k.
mike: great. next: can we enable basic telemetry for quality monitoring but strip PII?
jyoti: yes — enable telemetry, redact PII (email, ssn) per standard mask.
priyanka: wrapping up — action items:
- elaine: provision org + project + keys (ETA 2h)
- rachel-finance: recorded approval in billing (done)
- priyanka: send onboarding note and demo checklist to ACME

mike: appreciate it, team. will confirm demo time once org is ready. :thumbsup:
